notes.notes:

notes.title: MkIVb hotfix: Come back, BOMB is easy now!
notes.notes:
[h1]ːresistanceː New features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Indeed, the game is hard, so we've added an [b]Easy mode[/b] option in the "General" tab of the options menu. This only changes the difficulty in off-line game modes. It may need some adjustments so [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions]feedback is welcome[/url].
[*]Added an [b]Aim assist[/b] option in the "HUD" tab of options menu. This will display a "prediction" gunsight telling you where to aim to successfully shoot at enemies. Only active in off-line modes too.
[img]http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2015/08/2015-08-07_00002.jpg[/img]
[*]The [i]Billby[/i] is now fitted with a - silly - [b]landing gear[/b] :)
[img]http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2015/08/2015-08-07_00010.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1] ːresistanceː Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]A common crash during Act 2 mission transitions has been fixed
[*]Typos fixed and better English translations
[*]Music is now playing in the [i]"Welcome to Sidi Bandar"[/i] intro
[/list]

[h1]  ːwinoː Thank you [/h1]

notes.title: Update MkIIIt
notes.notes:
Well, it seems we have a few more letters in the alphabet, so we decided to use at least one of them before releasing the Mk IV !

This update contains two major changes:
[list]
[*]We've added some kind of [b]"return to base"[/b] objective in missions where it makes sense. This was a long time requested feature, and it is now implemented.
To go to the next mission you know have choice either to open the menu and select "next mission" as before or land/sea-land to a specific point.

[*][b]Airships are  now destructible in multiplayer[/b]. These are the first objects (apart from aircrafts) to be destructbile, and the buildings/ground vehicles/ships will come later, along with the external payloads.
Why are we doing this ? Well, it's kinda easy to understand: we are going to add new multiplayer game modes with more varied objectives, such as some kind of "airbase defense".
[/list]

We've also fixed some little bugs here and there:
[list]
[*]The icon/labels/objective markers position in triple screen mode is now correct.
[*]The mouse cursor can now go everywhere in oculus mode.
[*]Mouse look is now disabled in oculus mode.
[*]Minor shadow improvements and speed-up in both Direct3D and OpenGl.
[/list]

notes.title: Update MkIIIr - Hopefully the last before MkIV
notes.notes:
[h1]tl;dr; BOMB will come out from early access on January 2015.[/h1]

We have missed our December release window (i.e. before Steam’s Christmas sales) because the Mac version is not ready for prime time. So close to the end, it’s very important for us to release the game in a suitable state.

Also, we are experiencing trouble making the dedicated server work on Steam, but it’s getting solved. Expect it in a few days. However, before it's available for everyone, we'll try to have one on-line as often as possible.

Changelog isn't as amazing as one might expect:
[list]
[*]It's now possible to turn engines off and on again © (but that won't solve any problem if the engine is broken), default binding is set to 'i' key.
[*]Servers can now be password protected.
[/list] 
[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
We've made a first [url=http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/2014/12/17/custom-skin-creation-tutorial/]customization tutorial about how to create your own skins.[/url]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
The [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions/0/619574421268082193/]FAQ[/url] has also been updated.

Happy holidays and don't forget to gift BOMB all around you!

notes.title: Update MkIIIp
notes.notes:
Hi,

We've just released the Mk IIIp patch for BOMB. This patch is mostly related to "mouse control" but also brings some UI improvements.

Here is the complete changelog:
[list]
[*]New mouse control code. Still not perfect but [b]MUCH BETTER ![/b]
[*]Added a mouse look toggle key (default: "l alt") to enable mouse look when using mouse control
[*][b]Added a new first person view without cockpit[/b]. Press multiple times the "cockpit" view key/button (default "F1") to enable it. Also available for aircraft that do not have a cockpit yet
[*]Added an option to change icons opacity
[*]Added an option to display distance to enemy aircraft
[*]Moved the icons size and opacity sliders to the "HUD" tab of the options menu
[*]Keys and buttons options are now sorted alphabetically
[*]Fixed icons position
[*]Fixed joystick slider axis preview in the options menu
[/list]

Suggestion for the keyboard setup when using mouse control (if you're right-handed)
[list]
[*]Use WASD keys to manage roll and thrust
[*]Use Q and E for the yaw
[*]Map the zoom action to the L-Shift key
[*]Map the mouse look to L-Alt
[/list]

[b]NOTE: This is only a suggestion, you can use whatever binding you want.[/b]

Non editable actions: The mouse left buttons fires the internal guns, the right buttons fires the external guns, and mouse wheel switches between external guns.
Of course this may be changed according to player's feedback.

notes.title: Update Mk IIIi
notes.notes:
Hi,

This time we won't write a laconic change log about what has been done in the patch, but rather explain more precisely what has been fixed and what we are working on.

[b]The fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]We've made a few changes recently both to optimize memory consumption of the game and to make the game runs on Linux. Although the Linux version is not available right now, its development impacts the Windows version as most of the code and resources are common.

Because of that the last patch (Mk III[b]h[/b]) had some issues with the ocean and trees rendering when restarting a mission, [b]this is now fixed.[/b]

[*]We've also fixed a problem with the Track-Ir when the track-clip was out of the captor's sight.
[/list]
[b]The improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions/1/613936673532897888/]According to some feedbacks[/url], we've added a little black outline on some of the HUD elements to make them more visible.

[*]Another commonly asked feature is [b]checkpoints[/b]. The previous patch added one checkpoints in most of missions, which avoids the introduction phases when restarting the mission after a game-over.

[*]For the few and lucky players having a triple-monitor setup, we've also added a new option, named [b]HUD width[/b], allowing you to slightly change the HUD horizontal position, which may be necessary if the screens don't have the same resolution settings. This option is not really ergonomic yet and we are looking for better ways to do it, but it should do the job.


[/list]

[b]We are also aware some people want to try the multi-player[/b], and as there is unfortunately not enough players worldwide yet, we are looking for a way to organize some kind of event to make them meet.
As the multi-player mode stress-testing is also a reason for why we are releasing the game in early access, we really need it to be played :)

Finally, as the game is becoming more and stable, we will release updates less frequently, allowing us to make deeper and cleaner changes to improve the game. But don't be afraid, in case of major troubles we'll do a patch as soon as possible, otherwise we'll keep the rate of one update a week.

notes.title: Update Mk IIIc
notes.notes:
[b]Thanks to all customers having an Intel HD![/b]
We have found a major flaw in the texture management. By solving this issue we have greatly reduced the memory usage of BOMB, which is good for all computers !

Changelog of the [b]Mk IIIc[/b]:
[list]
[*]Added a check-box in the options menu to invert the joystick/gamepad axis if desired.
[*]Less crashes during loading, thanks to the memory fix.
[*]Game is now working on intel HD graphics. 
[/list]
Note that we are continuously optimizing the game to have better performances.
We will now work on other crashes reported by users and integrate the various suggestion that were made !
